title: Evolution of Consciousness: Where to Look for It
fullTitle: Soul Feast #63: Evolution of Consciousness: Where to Look for It

promo.text: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn How Here .

description: In this Soul Feast, Gary explores the monumental transformation occurring within human consciousness and explains why this shift is unprecedented. He describes how the old, five-sensory consciousness is rapidly giving way to a multi-sensory awareness – one that allows individuals to perceive beyond the physical world and understand themselves as more than minds and bodies. Through clear, grounded examples, Gary helps listeners recognize evolution unfolding both around them and within themselves, especially during moments of emotional challenge, conflict, and inner discomfort.

Gary goes deeper into how this unprecedented transformation reveals itself in everyday life – through social structures breaking down, heightened discord, and the collapse of systems built on external power.

At the same time, he explains how emotional awareness and inner examination help individuals witness evolution internally: in their physical sensations, their thoughts, and their movement between fear and love. This inside–outside perspective helps listeners see why the discomfort of the old world dissolving is part of the birth of a new, more conscious humanity.

Ultimately, Gary shows that evolution is not something to wait for – it is something each person can actively observe and participate in. The new consciousness expresses itself through emotional awareness, authentic power, and the growing recognition that love – not fear – is the true source of strength and meaning.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:
(01:12) — Why the shift from five-sensory to multisensory perception is happening at unprecedented speed
(03:40) — How discord, division, and collapsing social structures are signs of evolution – not deterioration
(06:45) — Why attempts to “fix” the old world with external power only create more conflict
(08:12) — How emotional awareness reveals the inner landscape of evolution through physical sensation and thought
(11:20) — The role of love and fear as the core dualities of Earth School
(13:01) — What it means to recognize yourself as “your perceptions” and why observer and observed are inseparable
(17:03) — A powerful soul step for experiencing the new consciousness directly

Take out your Soul Notebook and reflect on the phrase Gary offers in this Soul Feast: “I am my perceptions.” Instead of asking what it makes you think, explore what it makes you experience. Write down any sensations, shifts, doubts, openings, or insights that arise as you sit with these words. Return to the question multiple times: What did this cause me to experience?

Then observe where you notice evolution taking place both inside and outside yourself. Note how these moments feel in your body and how they shape your choices toward love or fear. Let this reflection help you participate consciously in your own transformation.
